substantiveFindings: Owner pass over the complete chapter: all 256 Chinese units with both English fields, all 8 people, 24 mention rows, 68 claims, 291 preflight candidates (287 dispositioned; the remaining 4 are consumed by the Fuxi, Nüwa and Jiang Yuan mentions), the date audit (31 items: 23 supported item checks, 1 finding covering 8 ids) and the 4 accepted editorial repairs.

No missing person. The square-mound and sun/moon protocols name only offices (司徒, 太常卿, 光祿卿, 良醖令, 宣徽使), deities (皇地祇, 神州地祇, 玄冥, 勾芒, 祝融, 後土, 蓐收, 大明, 青帝) and unnamed collectives (後妃嬪禦). The only individuated agents are the four Jin emperors and the four legendary Gaomei recipients.

One missing mention: s0256 上命後妃嬪禦皆執弓矢東向而射 is the emperor's own command in the Gaomei rite and is already attributed to Zhangzong (p004) by c0009, c0050 and c0051, but the extraction has no p004 surface in s0256. This is parallel to the captured 上 for p003 in s0243. An exact scoped mention addition is proposed; it passes the native extraction validator on a scratch copy (26 mentions, ok).

The three unnamed 'Emperor of Jin' records are correctly kept separate (c0041-c0043) and need no source-form change. Their reigning holders follow from the era names (Tianhui 4 = Taizong; Tianjuan 2 = Xizong; Dading 2/15/18 = Shizong). This is recorded only as canonical-certification evidence for the final reviewer: a bounded lookup (generation cb756c50…) returns three separate 'Emperor Shizong of Jin' dossiers (per_011X022J7CXXY3TQJW0A, per_2V2R42GHKYTBCNJ12JGY, per_F9QVZ997JHSH1AYE65FY), none of which currently lists jinshi:029:p003. Membership must be decided against the host-supplied candidate plan; no identity is asserted here.

Chronology: the independent audit (fresh canonical audit, 23 supported item checks) remains current. Its single finding concerns only the four legendary recipients' active-date hints, whose value is the literal text 'research required: …'. The completion rules treat this as a source-supported unknown, not a research gap: the chapter supplies no personal chronology for legendary figures. The owner proposes the native qualitative representation used for the Yellow Thearch in xintangshu/016 ('legendary antiquity'). It adds no date and keeps every dated cult-reception claim unchanged. The independent reviewer must decide it.

Definite English errors in 10 units (17 field edits): the literal fields left unrepaired beside two accepted idiomatic repairs (s0015, s0115); 內壝外 rendered as 'outside the outer embankment' (s0029); 壇下 rendered as 'on the altar' (s0037, s0038, s0060); 皆尚醖代(之) mistranslated as 'honoring the brewer's generation/stock' (s0102, s0108); 未三刻 mistranslated as 'three quarters before wei' (s0250); and the idiomatic field of s0256 omitting the second command 乃命. 太常卿 'Director of Grand Harmony', 尚書省 'Secretariat' and 宣徽使 'Palace Attendant' are loose renderings shared with other chapters; they are not changed here.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 又設饌幕於內濆東門之外，道北南向。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: They also set a food canopy outside the inner embankment's east gate, south of the path on the north side, facing south.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: They also set a food canopy outside the inner embankment's east gate, north of the path, facing south.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 道北南向 is north of the path, facing south. Accepted repair jinshi:029:r0001 corrected only the idiomatic field; the literal field still has the self-contradictory 'south of the path on the north side'.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 酉陛之南，金神蓐收、西嶽、西鎮、西海、西瀆於壇之第二等，昆侖、西山、西林、西川、西澤於內濆內，西丘、西陵、西墳、西衍、西原、西隰於內壝外，皆各為一列，以北為上。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: South of the you ascent: Metal Spirit Roushou, Western Marchmount, Western Garrison, Western Sea, and Western Stream on the altar's second tier; Kunlun, Western Mountain, Forest, River, and Western Marsh inside the inner embankment; Western Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the outer embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the north upward.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: South of the you ascent: Metal Spirit Roushou, Western Marchmount, Western Garrison, Western Sea, and Western Stream on the altar's second tier; Kunlun, Western Mountain, Forest, River, and Western Marsh inside the inner embankment; Western Mound, Hill, Tomb, Embankment, Plain, and Lowland outside the inner embankment—each in a single row, ranked from the north upward.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: The Chinese reads 西隰於內壝外 (outside the inner embankment), exactly parallel to the other three quarters in s0025-s0028; 'outside the outer embankment' is a mistranslation.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 酉陛之南，金神蓐收、西嶽、西鎮、西海、西瀆於壇之第二等，昆侖、西山、西林、西川、西澤於內濆內，西丘、西陵、西墳、西衍、西原、西隰於內壝外，皆各為一列，以北為上。

definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: Same error in the idiomatic field; 'outside it' matches the idiom of s0025-s0028 for 內壝外.

definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Two supervising censors were set—one southwest of the wu ascent on the altar, one northwest of the zi ascent—all east-facing.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Two supervising censors were set—one below the altar southwest of the wu ascent, one northwest of the zi ascent—all east-facing.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 壇下 means below the altar; the censors stand at ground level, not 'on the altar'.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 皆左實明水，右實玄酒，皆尚醖代。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: All had clear water on the left and dark wine on the right, all honoring the brewer's generation.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: All had clear water on the left and dark wine on the right, all substituted with wine from the Bureau of Imperial Fermentation.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 尚醖 is the Jin 尚醖署 (rendered 'Bureau of Imperial Fermentation' in jinshi/056 s0406) and 代 is 'substitute': the classical brews are replaced by the palace brewery's wine. 'honoring the brewer's generation' misreads 尚 as 'honor' and 代 as 'generation'.

definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Each had clear water left and dark wine right, all replaced with wine from the palace brewery.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 禮直官、贊者分引太常卿，光祿卿、丞、監禮、祭，太官令等詣內壝東門外省牲位。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: Ritual attendants and presenters in turn led the Director of Grand Harmony, the Director of Imperial Victuals and his aide, the supervising ritual academician, the supervising censor, the Imperial Kitchen director, and others to the outer victim station east of the inner embankment's gate.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: Ritual attendants and presenters in turn led the Director of Grand Harmony, the Director of Imperial Victuals and his aide, the supervising ritual academician, the supervising censor, the Imperial Kitchen director, and others to the victim-inspection station outside the inner embankment's east gate.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 內壝東門外省牲位 is the victim-inspection station outside the inner embankment's east gate. Accepted repair jinshi:029:r0002 fixed only the idiomatic field; the literal 'outer victim station east of the inner embankment's gate' keeps the same misplacement of 外 and drops 東門.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 前一日未三刻，布神位，省牲器，陳禦弓矢弓䪅於上下神位之右。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: On the previous day, three quarters before wei, they set out spirit seats, inspected victims and vessels, and displayed imperial bows, arrows, and quivers to the right of the upper and lower spirit seats.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: On the previous day, at the third quarter of the wei hour, they set out spirit seats, inspected victims and vessels, and displayed imperial bows, arrows, and quivers to the right of the upper and lower spirit seats.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 前一日未三刻 is 'on the previous day, at the third quarter (刻) of wei'; 前 belongs to 前一日. Compare s0111/s0114 未後二刻/未後三刻. 'three quarters before wei' is a mistranslation.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 前一日未三刻，布神位，省牲器，陳禦弓矢弓䪅於上下神位之右。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: The day before, three quarters before wei, they set the seats, inspected victims and vessels, and placed imperial bows, arrows, and quivers to the right of each seat.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: The day before, at the third quarter of wei, they set the seats, inspected victims and vessels, and placed imperial bows, arrows, and quivers to the right of each seat.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: Same mistranslation of 未三刻 in the idiomatic field.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 進胙官佩弓矢䪅以進，上命後妃嬪禦皆執弓矢東向而射，乃命以次飲福享胙。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: The flesh-bearer advanced wearing bow, arrows, and quiver; the emperor ordered consorts and palace women to take bows, face east, and shoot; then they drank the blessing and shared the sacrificial flesh in turn.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: The flesh-bearer advanced wearing bow, arrows, and quiver; the emperor ordered consorts and palace women to take bows, face east, and shoot; then he ordered them in turn to drink the blessing and share the sacrificial flesh.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: 乃命以次飲福享胙 is a second command by the emperor (上); the idiomatic 'then they drank the blessing' omits 命 and the emperor's agency, which the literal field and claim c0050 (ordered-consorts-to-shoot-and-share-sacrificial-flesh) both retain.
